counterfactuals: Substitute true held-room mean OR true held-room ratio only for explanatory diagnostics; both are oracle analyses, never deployable prediction scores.
complementarity: A versus C for P10 within each family; error correlation, C-better fraction and true-label per-record best-of-two diagnostic ceiling. No blending weights, model routing or hyperparameters selected.
